capabilities: Generate kanban columns from any base property
Drag cards between columns to update property values
Group the board into swimlanes by a second property
Create new notes from column plus buttons with values pre-filled
Reorder and collapse columns with saved per-view state
extras: Built with SortableJS. Cover image property is shared with Obsidian's native Cards view so one frontmatter field works in both. README covers installation, usage, sorting behavior, and the project's changeset-based release process.
intentEvidence: A kanban-style drag-and-drop custom view for Obsidian Bases
motivation: Inspired by the need for better task management in Obsidian Bases.
problem: Obsidian Bases has no kanban board, so notes cannot be organized into columns by a property and moved between values by dragging.
summary: Kanban view for Obsidian Bases that groups notes into property-based columns with drag-and-drop, swimlanes, and cover images.
